name: MedCOR Professionals
old_description: The Medical Suppliers with the Most Personalized Service in Maine
about:
MedCOR Professionals was founded in 1995 in Scarborough, Maine, as a medical supply store serving patients and clinics across New England. The company operates from a location in Scarborough Marketplace and has focused on supporting all phases of a patient's health and recovery for nearly three decades.

The business distributes a broad range of home medical products, including dynamic and static bracing, post-operative bras for breast surgery recovery, and pain management solutions. Beyond product supply, MedCOR provides services such as Medicare and insurance claim filing, vendor coordination for hard-to-find items, scheduled routine deliveries to clinics, and a generous return policy on most items.

Its customers include home-care patients, medical clinics, and healthcare providers throughout the region. The company works directly with product vendors to source equipment for specific clinical needs, from walking boots to clinic consumables, and emphasizes personalized assistance for both individual and institutional buyers.

MedCOR Professionals highlights its ACHC accreditation as a mark of compliance with national quality standards. The company states that its differentiated approach rests on personalized, compassionate service, direct vendor relationships, and operational support like insurance billing and scheduled deliveries that reduce administrative burden for clinics.
